description: The deposit provides training and test tables for a district-heating leakage-detection model, plus a raw confusion matrix for the published test results. The provider is Puning Xue and coauthors, Harbin Institute of Technology. Coverage: The tables reproduce part of one study. The metadata do not state the network location, measurement dates, sampling interval or number of faults. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: The package covers only the named study sections. Training labels, class balance and leakage scenarios require file and paper inspection before generalisation. For simulation it supports comparison of leakage classifiers and inspection of reported test outcomes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
